title: Divine Rivals
author: Rebecca Ross
summary: Two rival young journalists compete for a column at a newspaper while the gods are at war. In secret, one of them starts exchanging letters with a stranger through an enchanted typewriter.
readIf: you like letters, slow-burn romance and a gentle historical-fantasy atmosphere.
skipIf: you want fast-paced action or spice, since the focus is on emotion, letters and the cost of war.

pairings.reason: Another story about hope, writing and love in a world at war.
Shares the romance between two rivals in a beautifully imagined magical setting.
An older story of a bright, ambitious girl with a love of words and a rival who becomes something more.
